samples: This program generates a plain-text invoice report by printing formatted rows for each invoice showing the customer name, number of line items, and total amount, then displays the grand total across all invoices. It demonstrates how to reuse an invoice calculation module to build a higher-level reporting tool. The example output shows two sample invoices (ACME and Globex) sorted alphabetically with their respective totals and a combined grand total.

This program generates a plain-text invoice report by printing formatted rows for each invoice showing the customer name, number of line items, and total amount, then displays the grand total across all invoices.
